cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 14th Jan 2026 (NZDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 14th Jan 2026 (NZDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

privates.name: Standard 4 Bed Private Shared Bathroom
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription:
Embrace the laid-back vibe of The Nest, where comfort meets convenience in a serene garden setting. Sleep well on comfortable beds, relax on bean bags and connect via free wifi.
All bedding, towels and hot water bottles supplied. Close to facilities.

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.
